title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Customer Service
description: The Advanced Professional Certificate in Customer Service Provides the learner with essential skills building to better serve customers and enhance the organization service delivery.
longDescription: Understand the fundamentals of customer service, Customer types and expectations. Understand and apply 10 rules for great customer service and appreciate the role of internal and external customers of the organization. Understand and apply baby steps in customer service Understand the importance of a positive attitude and step to develop a positive attitude Understand the needs to maintain ethics in customer service Understand and apply steps to build a long-lasting relationship with customers Understand and apply the six steps to effective communication to enhance the customer service Understand and apply the steps to effectively handle difficult customers Understand and apply 7 Pillars of customer service with researched-based practical examples Understand the ways and etiquettes to make effective contact with the customer Understand and apply the steps for face to face conversation with the customer The Advanced Professional Certificate in Customer Service Provides the learner with essential skills building to better serve customers and enhance the organization service delivery. The learner will be able to develop key behaviours and master responses to produce customer happiness and loyalty while achieving a better brand image.
